mechanism_of_action: Liver-directed ACC1/2 inhibition; the combination also includes a DGAT2 inhibitor.
primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in liver fat assessed by MRI-PDFF at 16 weeks (monotherapy trial) and 6 weeks (combination trial).
efficacy_outcome: At 16 weeks, liver-fat reductions were dose-dependent with PF-05221304: −49.9%, −55.9% and −64.8% at 10, 25 and 50 mg QD, versus −7.2% with placebo. At 6 weeks, placebo-adjusted reductions were −44.6% with PF-05221304 plus PF-06865571, −44.5% with PF-05221304 alone and −35.4% with PF-06865571 alone.
safety_signal: With PF-05221304 monotherapy, serum triglycerides increased in 23/305 patients (8%), leading to withdrawal in 13/305 (4%); other serum lipids also increased dose-dependently. Combination-treatment AEs occurred in 10/28 patients (36%), with no AE-related discontinuations, and the triglyceride effect was mitigated.
